title: Instrument deprecated event delivery usage in production
objective: Continue Repository Step 17 with deterministic, production-shaped usage telemetry for deprecated exact-version event contracts. Generate one consumer-expanded runtime catalog from the governed lifecycle policy and canonical event registry, observe only deliveries successfully claimed or returned through the shared PostgreSQL event-history boundary, and expose zero-seeded low-cardinality Prometheus evidence without tenant, actor, request, event instance, payload, aggregate, status or error data.
deliverables: generate deterministic capability and consumer-expanded event telemetry catalogs from every deprecated lifecycle entry
derive each event provider and internal consumer from the canonical published registry rather than lifecycle ownership metadata
fail Contract CI when lifecycle policy, published event consumers and the committed runtime telemetry catalog drift
publish one synchronous event-delivery observer from the existing capability-adapters telemetry factory without adding a public Rust item
attach the observer to the shared PostgreSQL store used by production delivery workers and projection/history consumers
count a deprecated exact-version event only after a successful delivery lease claim or when returned in a consumer event-history page
exclude raw immutable event reconstruction, missing events, inactive consumers, not-ready leases and failed claims from usage counts
preseed deterministic zero-valued event series for every governed provider-consumer delivery coordinate
expose event type, version, provider module, consumer module and lookback only
prove the observer cannot change event-delivery outcomes even if observation panics
preserve existing capability telemetry, delivery ordering, lease semantics, projection replay, public responses and accepted complexity ceilings
acceptance: the branch is based exactly on main commit 0c6a1f3505ee416a6962ca2eac4c29fdf96700b9 and contains only the fourteen declared event telemetry packet files
the current empty deprecation policy produces deterministic empty capability and event-delivery catalogs without fabricated runtime series
a synthetic deprecated event expands into one sorted runtime series per canonical internal consumer and uses the canonical provider module
duplicate, malformed or unpublished event telemetry and duplicate published event consumers fail closed
raw event reconstruction and cross-tenant non-disclosure reads do not increment usage
each successfully returned history delivery and each successfully acquired delivery lease increment exactly once
not-ready, inactive, missing, completed and failed claims do not increment usage
exact event type, version, provider and consumer matching is required; wrong coordinates do not increment
Prometheus rendering remains deterministic and contains no tenant, actor, request, correlation, trace, payload, aggregate, delivery, event-instance, status or error labels
observer panic is isolated and cannot change the PostgreSQL delivery result
no new crate, package, dependency, Cargo.lock entry, database schema, migration, protobuf coordinate, module manifest, worker algorithm or business route
one unchanged meaningful user-authored head passes every applicable permanent workflow and final changed-file, comment, review and thread inspection
Repository Step 17 remains in progress; a representative real deprecation, governed consumer migration, retirement proof and final evidence synchronization are not falsely claimed
crm-application-runtime remains at or below 7269 non-comment LOC and 130 public items, while workspace public items remain at or below 5377
non_goals: complete Repository Step 17 or synchronize final Step 17 closure evidence
deprecate, migrate or retire any currently published capability or event
observe external consumers that do not execute through this in-process runtime
count event publication, raw immutable event reconstruction, failed lease acquisition or delivery outcome status
add tenant, actor, request, correlation, trace, payload, aggregate, event id, delivery id, status or error-code metric dimensions
add network or database I/O to telemetry recording
change event history selection, delivery lease, retry, dead-letter, projection or transaction semantics
implement local lifecycle Step 18, Customer Privacy worker Step 19, frontend or product closure
declare Phase 8A complete, Customer Privacy complete or architecture 10/10
